text:
Elena (CFO): quick follow-up from the all-hands finance section re: runway and approvals. capturing answers here.
Diego (Eng): thanks  can you confirm runway in months?
Elena (CFO): base-case ~16 months using current signed ARR. stress case ~10-11 months if growth slows.
Marta (Hiring): should we pause offers in pipeline?
Elena (CFO): not a freeze. Only roles labeled 'mission-critical' by hiring committee proceed; others paused for weekly review.
Diego (Eng): procurement thresholds for infra (GPUs / cloud)?
Asha (FinanceOps): effective now: < $25k = budget owner; $25k-$150k = owner + finance manager; > $150k = owner + director + CFO review. multi-year prepaids flagged for ROI doc.
Diego (Eng): expedited approval for customer-required on-prem gear?
Elena (CFO): tag as 'customer-critical', loop Sales+Solutions+FinanceOps; we'll triage within 48h.
Sam (CEO): product experiments still funded selectively  small set, OKR-aligned, 6-8 week milestones.
BudgetBot: automated: "infra-effort: target 12% run-rate reduction in 90 days via batching, spot, quantization."
Asha (FinanceOps): procurement form required: https://redwood.internal/procure. include vendor, term, ARR impact, GL code. incomplete forms returned.
Marta (Hiring): headcount planning cadence?
Asha (FinanceOps): quarterly HC forecast remains; add mid-quarter checkpoints when spend hits 70% of plan.
Diego (Eng): will product/eng get per-route cost metrics?
Sam (CEO): yes  Console will show per-route token cost & latency next sprint; teams can request early access.
Elena (CFO): actions: finance FAQ in #finance by EOD tomorrow; approval matrix updated; hiring rubric published. DM Asha/Me for urgent/private items.
Diego (Eng): thanks  who's the finance contact for GPU budgets?
Asha (FinanceOps): that's me  I'll host weekly infra budget office hours. invite soon.
Elena (CFO): closing  recap: runway ~16 months base; updated approval thresholds; procurement form required; hiring prioritization.
